capabilities: create and edit Kanban boards stored as .kanban JSON files in the vault
sort open tasks with an Eisenhower matrix and pairwise priority duels
track card deadlines with due-date coloring and optional due-first display
aggregate all completed cards across boards into a day-grouped log
grow a per-label radar chart of completed work with historical comparison
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; must be installed via BRAT or manually from a GitHub release. Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or newer as of version 1.1.2. Card action buttons are hover-revealed and easier to use with a pointer than on touch devices.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to manage todos on a Kanban board, let alone prioritize them with structured methods or visualize completed work over time.
summary: Kanban board plugin that stores boards as .kanban JSON files and adds an Eisenhower matrix, pairwise priority sorting, a done log, and a skill radar chart.
